curated-cinzel-decorative-fs-supreme: Regal swagger, with a possible detour into graffiti style lettering. Cinzel Decorative ripples faintly across wide-set capitals while Supreme lays a heavy, dense strip of plain sans beneath, grounding it.
curated-cinzel-decorative-gf-alumni-sans: Cinzel Decorative spreads its capitals wide, with stencil-cut letters and bar widths that vary only mildly across each word. Over pages, Alumni Sans Pinstripe knits into tight, uniform texture.
curated-cinzel-decorative-gf-arimo: Arimo reads openly, with a tall mean line and generous gaps. Cinzel Decorative leads with widely spaced capitals and tame contrast, fit for a wizard school crest, while this sans lets text run on page after page without tiring.
curated-cinzel-decorative-gf-candal: Open capitals above, closed-up curves below. Cinzel Decorative does its best work in commanding, widely spaced capitals, while Candal, generously letterspaced with wide porthole counters, handles the quieter lowercase.
curated-cinzel-decorative-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans keeps its stroke widths constant, stem to curve. What stands out most is the gentle modulation of Cinzel Decorative against that flat, unvarying line, one soft and one clean.
curated-cinzel-decorative-gf-geist: Cinzel Decorative has ink-trace strokes and a restrained thick-thin ratio. It earns its keep big and brief, say for property management, beside Geist, a sans with one stroke width and wide openings.
curated-cinzel-decorative-gf-golos-text: Golos Text reads big and friendly, its x-height filling the line. Beneath Cinzel Decorative's gently modulated capitals, this sans-serif keeps one stroke width and a wide-parted s, so paragraphs flow without snagging.
curated-cinzel-decorative-gf-league-goth: League Gothic is tall-waisted and cramped, built for quick bursts of text. Open, widely spaced capitals are where Cinzel Decorative thrives; tight, closed letters are League Gothic's territory.
curated-cinzel-decorative-gf-magra: Big-bodied lowercase makes every word feel sturdy and low in contrast. Magra is the workhorse for text, while Cinzel Decorative earns attention with widely spaced, commanding capitals.
curated-cinzel-decorative-gf-major-mono-: Major Mono Display reads like neon tubing, spaced wide on every side. Cinzel Decorative brings comfortable stroke variation and refined capitals, while the monospace body keeps constant-width strokes precise and technical.
